translation: Gather in the ninth and tenth months, dry in the shade. Original text of the Benjing: Bitter orange (枳實), flavor bitter, cold. It chiefly treats great wind within the skin, itching as with hemp-beans (如麻豆苦癢), dispels cold-heat bindings, stops diarrhea, lengthens muscle and flesh, benefits the five viscera, and boosts qi ...
